## What we do

eForte is an AI transformation partner. We design and build production systems around three named pillars:

1. Velocity AI — ship AI-augmented software with measurable outcomes
2. Agentic Orchestration — coordinate agents, tools, people, and data in live workflows
3. Foundational Data Layer — governed data from ingestion through analytics and GenAI

We also deliver capability studios (product design, AI, data, apps, cloud/SRE, cybersecurity, platform engineering, QA, product management, blockchain, staff augmentation) and industry-specific programs.
